analysis.title: Xometry Inc. (XMTR) Q3'26 Earnings Review: Upside Revenue Momentum Continues; 2027 is Setting Up as Year of Convergence on Key Product and Platform Initiatives
key_insights: GS reiterates Neutral on Xometry and raises its 12-month price target to $107 from $104, with the stock at $95.49 (12.1% upside). The firm sees a balanced risk/reward skew.
Q3'26 revenue was $252m against $235m GS and $236m consensus (+7% vs both) and company guidance of $234-236m. Adj. EBITDA was $21m vs $17m consensus and $16-17m guidance.
Marketplace revenue grew 40%+ for a third straight quarter (43% in Q3) and passed a $1B annual revenue run rate, a long-held company target for establishing scale.
Revenue from the largest customers grew more than 40% YoY, driven by deeper wallet share, better client integration and less workflow friction.
Marketplace revenue per active buyer rose 19% YoY, and Adj. EBITDA margin expanded about 510bps YoY.
AI-driven improvements across costs, sourcing, recommendations, conversion, acquisition and pricing are cited as raising efficiency, unit economics and market share.
The beta launch of the Siemens integration, built natively into Siemens Designcenter, is set for Q1 2027.
FY26 Adj. EBITDA and revenue guidance were raised on marketplace momentum, advertising leverage, gross margin expansion and opex discipline.
Growth is guided to slow in Q4: total revenue +32-33% (vs 40% in Q3) and Marketplace +35-36% (vs 43% in Q3).

Services revenue lags the marketplace (+2% in Q3, Q4 guided flat to slightly up), which limits the contribution from the higher-margin services line. International remains a drag on consolidated Adj. EBITDA margin.
GS expects investor debate to center on FY27 guidance at the next earnings report, any data on the Siemens impact, and execution pace against the macro backdrop.
GS raises Q4'26 revenue to $256m (from $248m) and Adj. EBITDA to $22.0m (from $20.6m). 2027 revenue is essentially unchanged at $1.15bn, while 2027 Adj. EBITDA is cut to $110m from $115m.
GAAP EPS estimates fall sharply: 2026 to $(0.10) from $0.10, 2027 to $0.28 from $1.12, 2028 to $0.94 from $1.99.

The price target blends 13.0x EV/Gross Profit on NTM+1 estimates with a modified DCF at 42.0x EV/GAAP EBITDA (raised from 30.0x) on NTM+4 estimates, discounted 3 years at 12%. GS raised the multiple for increased visibility into the forward operating trajectory.

market_movers.rationale: Neutral reiterated with PT raised to $107 from $104 after a revenue and EBITDA beat and raised FY26 guide. GS sees balanced risk/reward at $95.49.

International remains a drag on consolidated Adj. EBITDA margin.
